name: Street Fighter 6
short_description: A side-on one-on-one fighting game with a big cast, a simple control mode for newcomers and a city to explore.
sources: oracle study 2026-10-23 (public knowledge, no store fetch, no game files)
summary: A side-on one-on-one fighting game with a big cast, a simple control mode for newcomers and a city to explore.

identity.core_loop: Two fighters face off; read, move, poke, block, punish, spend the gauge on a big move; best of three rounds.
identity.ui_and_game_feel: Heavy, crunchy and readable; each hit pauses for a beat so you feel it.

hud_coverage.method: Oracle study from public knowledge of the game, in our own words; not yet measured on capture

information_grammar.note: Health and power bars along the top, a round timer, combo counters and big text callouts. Bodies show stun and fatigue, and a hit's size shows in the hit-stop and the splash.

identity.art_direction: Muscular stylised characters with physical materials and bright paint-splash effects on every big move.

rendering.signature: Physical materials on exaggerated muscular bodies; the style comes from bright paint and ink splashes that burst out of every big hit.
rendering.source: oracle rendering study 2026-10-23 (public knowledge, no captures, no game files)
rendering.lesson: Let the hit effects carry the style: a paint-splash language on top of ordinary materials reads as cartoon impact without gore.

tricks: In-house mocap actors perform each fighter's moves; capture is fed straight into the RE Engine
Capcom built real-time preview of capture inside the engine, so animators see it on the character at once
Captured motion is then pushed into strong key poses with hit-stop, so every hit reads
motion.lesson: Capture for weight and timing, then exaggerate the key poses and freeze the contact frame.

sources.title: Dashfight: Capcom shows its RE Engine mocap technique in SF6

identity.audio_mood: Hip-hop and street beats, crowd noise, a live commentator option.
identity.lessons_for_abbies_world: Make every hit readable: wind-up, contact pause, splash, reaction. A one-button 'easy' control mode lets anyone play the same fight.
